source_title: Verstappen leads Red Bull 1-2 as both Leclerc and Sainz retire in Azerbaijan — Formula 1 official race report
evidence_summary: FastF1 records PitInTime for Leclerc on lap 20 and no PitOutTime. The FIA Race Pit Stop Summary lists his service stop on lap 9, not lap 20; the official F1 race report states that after the engine failure he crawled back to the pits to retire. Under the current target (any pit-lane visit), the lap-20 entry is confirmed as a visit, not a tyre-service stop.
